title: Japan: Chūbu (Nagoya and region) coverage gap
description: Coverage-gap pass 2026-10-06: indoor bouldering gyms in the Chūbu prefectures (Aichi, Gifu, Mie, Shizuoka, Nagano, Niigata, Toyama, Ishikawa, Fukui, Yamanashi) missing from Bouldeer. Each gym confirmed open with bouldering on its own site or official social account.
